title: Semantic Kind Properties for Bundles Folders Definitions
description: Expand bundle, folder, definition to have semantic kind properties. Add filtering by kind, time, contributor, policy, and breach-kind dimensions. Update VS Code extension filter tree.
summary: Implemented semantic kind properties for Bundle (library/schema/binary/ui/site/assets), Folder (organization/required), and Definition (implementation/interface/constant). Added filtering by all new kind dimensions. Updated VS Code FilterProvider with hierarchical filter tree for bundle kinds, folder kinds, and definition kinds.
